name: Foundation
overview: Scripture emphasizes the critical importance of a firm and secure foundation, illustrated by the imagery of a house built on a rock that withstands storms (Matthew 7:24; Luke 6:48). Christ is revealed as the precious corner stone and sure foundation laid by God in Zion, upon which the church is built and cannot be overcome by evil (Isaiah 28:16; Matthew 16:18). The psalmist warns that if foundations are destroyed, the righteous are left vulnerable, highlighting the necessity of building on God's established decrees and truths (Psalms 11:3; Psalms 118:22). Together, these verses portray the foundation as both the doctrinal and spiritual bedrock securing believers, their hope, and God’s kingdom.
